title: Read only when present
summary: Swift: Read only when present. Try nil and observe that nothing prints.
introduction: if let unwraps an optional only when it contains a value. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Read only when present with Swift
Try nil and observe that nothing prints

blocks.text: Install Swift or use Xcode on a Mac. Save each example as lesson.swift and run swift lesson.swift.

blocks.title: Read only when present
blocks.code:
let score: Int? = 8
if let value = score { print(value) }

blocks.text: if let finds 8 inside the optional. It binds that value for use inside the block.
Try nil and observe that nothing prints.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: The unwrapped value exists only inside its block.
